mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which triggers a policy response from the Federal Reserve, leading to lower long-term interest rates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint Rank IC across both series is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the probability of a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 272.0 in a single month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain or increase interest rates, which increases discount rates on equity cash flows and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a strong rebound in aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in payroll employment growth below 100,000 in a single month signals labor market weakness, which increases the likelihood of a Fed rate cut, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
